brand.name: CAn
brand.mission: To engineer clean, high-performance functional hydration with zero artificial chemistry, packaged exclusively in infinitely recyclable aluminum.
brand.metaDescription: CAn is a next-generation functional beverage formulated with 450mg ionic electrolytes, alpine spring purity, and zero artificial sweeteners in infinitely recyclable aluminum cans.

hero.headline: REFRESH YOUR ENGINE
hero.subheadline: Crafted for high performers. Pure alpine mountain water charged with bioavailable ionic electrolytes and organic botanical adaptogens.
